component.name: ASCII Saver
component.summary: Animated terminal effect screensaver for GNOME and KDE

description.p: ASCII Saver displays custom artwork with randomized terminal text animations when the desktop session becomes idle. It supports multiple monitors, GNOME Shell and KDE Plasma, and dismisses the overlay on lock.
The control panel manages automatic activation, idle delay, typography, colors, frame rate, artwork, previews, and installation diagnostics.
